name: TC-02-rbac-permissions
description: TC-02.1: RBAC Permission Matrix — Navigate to permissions configuration and verify role/entity matrix

doc_metadata.title: TC-02.1 — Admin Panel
doc_metadata.caption: Navigate to the Admin panel to access role and permission configuration.

doc_metadata.title: TC-02.1 — Admin Overview
doc_metadata.caption: The Admin panel provides access to user management, role configuration, and permission matrix settings.

doc_metadata.title: TC-02.1 — Role List
doc_metadata.caption: Navigate to the Role entity. Roles define what actions users can perform on each entity type.

doc_metadata.title: TC-02.1 — Role Configuration
doc_metadata.caption: The role list shows all configured roles (Admin, Manager, Technician, Viewer, etc.) with their associated permissions and data scopes.

doc_metadata.title: TC-02.1 — Permission Matrix
doc_metadata.caption: Navigate to the Permission entity. The permission matrix defines Create, Read, Update, Delete (CRUD) access per role per entity.

doc_metadata.title: TC-02.1 — Permission Matrix Detail
doc_metadata.caption: The permission matrix shows each role-entity combination with granular CRUD controls. Admins can toggle individual permissions to restrict or grant access.
